description: HP-80 is the Registration and Licensing Authority (R&LA) office located in Haroli, Una district of Himachal Pradesh. It handles various transport services including vehicle registration, driving license issuance, and road tax collection for the Haroli sub-division. The office serves as a critical administrative unit for automotive governance in the region bordering Punjab.
address: Sub Divisional Office, Haroli, District Una, Himachal Pradesh - 177220
